comparison.objective: Capture distributed battery-cell spring preload with a pressure plate and cross-key, versus collet-nut preassembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Compress a plate over twelve springs while inserting a separate key; candidate captures one eccentric lip through changing-axis tilt and roll.
comparison.success_condition: Requires twelve contacts within compression limits and a seated key; candidate requires continuous ring retention for 3 seconds and a withdrawal check. Candidate has no numeric snap-force limit.
comparison.reason: Both create retained preload, but the mechanisms and tested coordination are meaningfully different.
